name: amfx-claims-vs-nfp-3mma-research
description: amFX reproduction (25OCT22 p2): US Initial Claims vs 3-month moving average of NFP monthly change. Even after smoothing NFP with a 3MMA, Claims are still more timely at turning points. Both normalized to percentile rankings. Claims inverted. Source: Brent Donnelly, Spectra Markets.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: INITIAL CLAIMS VS 3-MONTH AVG NFP (25OCT22 p2)
# =============================================================================
# Even after smoothing NFP with a 3-month moving average, it is STILL
# not as timely as raw weekly Initial Claims.
# =============================================================================

# Total Nonfarm Payrolls (monthly, FRED: PAYEMS)
payems_src = economic_indicators(series_id='PAYEMS')()
nfp_change = returns(type=ReturnsType.monetary)(payems_src.result)
nfp = ffill(nfp_change)

# 3-month moving average of NFP change (~63 trading days)
nfp_3mma = ma(period=63)(nfp)

idx = index()

xy_lines(
    title='NFP 3-Month Average: Still Noisy and Laggy',
    category='Claims vs NFP 3MMA',
    y_axis_label='NFP 3MMA (thousands)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.IntegerFormat,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NFP 3-Month MA', color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(idx, nfp_3mma)
